Idun Synnøve Bråten is a 26-year-old Norwegian woman from Ålesund, Norway.

She has a softly athletic and tall sturdy build.

Her complexion is fair neutral complexion, with realistic natural skin texture and natural freckles.

Her facial features include soft rounded features, straight, natural, medium, and thick.

Her eyes are green-grey, with almond-shaped features.

Her hair is shoulder length, thick, medium-brown wavy shoulder-length hair, face-framing strands, and medium brown.
